info.text:
The typical US home costs nearly five years of household income.
Harvard JCHS: price-to-income was 4.7 in 2025, vs about 3.2 in the 1990s; existing-home prices up 54% since 2020.
NAR median existing-home price: $346,900 in 2021, a record $414,400 in 2025.
Why: a shortage Freddie Mac put at ~3.7M homes (2024), 30-year rates at 7.03% (Sept 24, 2026), and owners locked into cheap old mortgages.
Example: 10% down on Aug 2026's $429,100 median = ~$2,577/mo at 7.03% vs ~$1,628 at 3%.
Sources: Harvard JCHS 2026; NAR; Freddie Mac.
News and education, not financial advice.
